lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular 2D grid. The mid-to-posterior section (right) contains larger, discrete centroids with high luminance, while the anterior section (left) contains smaller, higher-density clusters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with circular blobs. Specifically, sinuous vertical bands on the right side of the flank encapsulate large spots, forming grid-like anchor nodes along the vertical axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear horizontal feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from light (upper) to shadow (lower).

other_distinctive_markers: Unique non-linear, horseshoe-shaped vertical luminance bands on the posterior flank that deviate from standard linear striping.
